## About
Shield Auto Glass is a small auto glass shop on W Clarendon St in Gladstone. Customers know it as Nate's shop, and reviewers mention working with Nate and his brother.
We fix chipped and cracked windshields when they can be saved, replace them when they can't, and handle side windows too. We'll tell you honestly what to expect before we start, including when a crack might not hold.
Drivers from Gladstone and around the greater PDX area have rated us 5 stars across 312 Google reviews. If a rock just caught your windshield on the way to work, give us a call.

## Services
- Crack repair: If a rock chip in your windshield has started to spread, we'll try to save it before replacing it, and we'll be upfront that a crack can sometimes spread during the repair.
- Get your windshield replaced: When a crack is too far gone, we put in a new windshield. Quote online with your VIN and photos, then book an appointment.
- Window replacement: Side window replacement for your car. One reviewer had a window replaced on their Audi.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Use the quote form on our website. Enter your VIN and share photos of the damage, and we'll get back to you with a price.

Q: Can you come to me?
A: Yes. One reviewer had their windshield replaced right in their own driveway.

Q: When are you open?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, every day of the week. Give us a call to set up a time.
